_about: Public-domain John Daniel Jones (1865-1942), Congregational minister of Richmond Hill Church, Bournemouth, for the Word Hoard: his books printed before 1930: The Lord of Life and Death (1900), Paul's Certainties (1900), The Gospel of the Sovereignty (1900), The Glorious Company of the Apostles (1904), Things Most Surely Believed (1908), If a Man Die (1918), The Gospel according to St. Mark, a devotional commentary (4 vols., catalogued 1919) and The King of Love (1922). Texts are from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 80 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

jdjones-lord-of-life-death: The Lord of life and death (New York : George H. Doran, [19-)
jdjones-pauls-certainties: Paul's certainties, and other sermons (New York : Fleming H. Revell, 1900)

jdjones-if-a-man-die: If a man die (New York : G. H. Doran, 1918)
jdjones-mark-1: The Gospel according to St. Mark : a devotional commentary (London : Religious Tract Society, 1919)
jdjones-mark-2: The Gospel according to St. Mark : a devotional commentary (London : Religious Tract Society, 1919)
